title: 第23章 无冕之王第24章 你没经验
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 听莫阳这么一说，太上长老顿时皱了皱眉。
思索了片刻，点头道：“很多强者确实性子古怪，既然他不让你透露，那便不说，以免惹那位前辈不高兴，对你不利！”
莫阳趁机转移话题，开口道：“老头，有什么事就直说！”
太上长老顿时瞪眼，在整个灵虚宗，没有人敢像莫阳这样称呼他，莫阳倒好，一口一个老头，一口一个老家伙，叫得异常麻溜，如今还越发顺口了。
“小子，你知不知道什么叫尊老？”他瞪着莫阳，开口冷哼。
“有事快说，别打扰我修炼！”莫阳满脸不耐烦的开口。
莫阳知道这老家伙无事不登三宝殿，这一大清早的就来木峰找他，铁定没好事。
“小子，四宗门的武道盛会快到了……”
只是太上长老还未说完，莫阳便直接摇头道：“这和我有什么关系，我不参加！”
“小子，你别忘了你也是灵虚宗的一份子，而且以往你也知道，每次武道盛会，四长老都会亲自领队前往，这五年来，其他三宗门一直在背后嘲笑我们灵虚宗，四长老若是还活着……”
太上长老说着也轻叹了一声，没有继续说下去。
因为提到四长老，莫阳神色便低落下来。
莫阳脸上闪过一丝忧伤，虽然他知道太上长老是故意用四长老来激他，不过说的也是事实。
以往每年武道盛会，四长老都会亲自带领灵虚宗的弟子前往盛会地点，他还清楚的记得每次归来时四长老脸上那失落的神色。
曾经的他，有心无力，而今，他已经有了力量。
莫阳微微沉默，心中已经有了决定，此次盛会，他得去！
他之前所说的守孝百日已经快到了，他知道自己或许在灵虚宗待不了多久了。
“也罢，就当弥补师父的遗憾，我去！”莫阳说完便直接转身走进了屋中，啪的一声将房门关上。
“混账小子……”太上长老愣了愣，低骂了一声。
太上长老在小院中默默立了片刻，神色复杂地朝莫阳所在的屋子看了一眼，也只能转身离开。
他今日是有意用四长老来刺激莫阳，此时心中终于放心下来，虽然没有探查出莫阳的具体修为，但他感觉莫阳比前段时间又变强了不少。
在他猜测中，莫阳的修为至少都达到地玄境三阶巅峰了。
有莫阳参加，此次灵虚宗夺冠的可能很大，毕竟最近因为莫阳兑换丹药，很多弟子修为都有所突破，连徐欣都已经迈入地玄境了，灵虚宗弟子的实力已经增长了不少。
两天后，有消息传出，二长老居然突破了！
听到这消息，灵虚宗一众长老都惊讶不已。
因为二长老修为已经有十余年了不曾突破过了，而且他年纪确实很大了，这些年来，修为非但难以寸进，反而有退后的迹象。
让其他长老更加吃惊的是，二长老突破后两天不到的时间，一同去闭关的大长老竟然也突破了。
这下灵虚宗的一众长老彻底震惊！
大长老的修为比二长老高了两个小境界，但他们的情况几乎一样，这些年来两人皆是一直停滞不前，隐隐还有跌退的趋势。
但几天内相继突破，这显然不是偶然！
content_en:
Hearing what Mo Yang said, the Supreme Elder frowned immediately.
After thinking for a moment, he nodded and said: "Many strong men do have weird tempers. Since he won't let you reveal it, then don't tell it, so as not to make that senior unhappy and be detrimental to you!"
Mo Yang took the opportunity to change the subject and said: "Old man, if you have anything to say, just tell me!"
The Supreme Elder immediately glared. In the entire Lingxu Sect, no one dared to call him like Mo Yang. Mo Yang, on the other hand, sounded like an old man and an old guy. His name was extremely smooth, and now he is even more fluent.
"Boy, do you know what respecting the elders means?" He glared at Mo Yang and snorted coldly.
"If you have anything to say, please don't disturb my practice!" Mo Yang said with an impatient look on his face.
Mo Yang knew that this old guy didn't go to the Three Treasures Hall for any reason, so he came to Mufeng to look for him this early in the morning, which was definitely up to him.
"Boy, the martial arts festival of the four sects is coming soon..."
But before the Supreme Elder finished speaking, Mo Yang shook his head and said: "What does this have to do with me? I won't participate!"
"Boy, you..."
"Boy, don't forget that you are also a member of Lingxu Sect. In the past, you also knew that at every martial arts event, the fourth elder would personally lead the team there. In the past five years, the other three sects have been laughing at our Lingxu Sect behind our backs. If the fourth elder is still alive..."
The Supreme Elder sighed softly as he spoke and did not continue.
Mo Yang's expression darkened because of the mention of the Fourth Elder.
A trace of sadness flashed across Mo Yang's face. Although he knew that the Supreme Elder deliberately used the Fourth Elder to provoke him, what he said was also true.
In the past, the fourth elder would personally lead the disciples of Lingxu Sect to the venue of the grand gathering every year. He still clearly remembered the disappointed look on the face of the fourth elder when he returned every time.
He used to be powerless, but now he has strength.
Mo Yang was silent for a moment, having already made a decision in his heart. He had to go to this grand event!
The hundred days of observing filial piety that he mentioned before were coming soon, and he knew that he might not be able to stay in Lingxu Sect for long.
"Forget it, just make up for Master's regret, I'll go!" After Mo Yang said that, he turned around and walked into the house, closing the door with a bang.
"You bastard..." The Supreme Elder was stunned and cursed.
The Supreme Elder stood silently in the small courtyard for a moment, glanced at the room where Mo Yang was with a complicated expression, and could only turn around and leave.
He deliberately used the Fourth Elder to stimulate Mo Yang today, and at this moment he finally felt relieved. Although he did not find out Mo Yang's specific cultivation level, he felt that Mo Yang had become much stronger than before.
According to his guess, Mo Yang's cultivation level has at least reached the peak of the third level of the Earth Profound Realm.
With Mo Yang participating, Lingxu Sect has a high chance of winning the championship this time. After all, many disciples have made breakthroughs in their cultivation recently because of Mo Yang's redemption of elixirs. Even Xu Xin has entered the Earth Mysterious Realm. The strength of Lingxu Sect's disciples has increased a lot.
Two days later, news came out that the second elder had actually made a breakthrough!
Upon hearing the news, all the elders of Lingxu Sect were surprised.
Because the second elder has not made a breakthrough in cultivation for more than ten years, and he is indeed very old. Over the years, not only has his cultivation been difficult to make progress, but he has shown signs of retreating.
What surprised the other elders even more was that less than two days after the second elder's breakthrough, the first elder who went to retreat together also broke through.
The elders of Lingxu Sect were completely shocked!
The first elder's cultivation level is two small realms higher than that of the second elder, but their situation is almost the same. Over the years, both of them have been stagnant and have a faint tendency to decline.
But the breakthroughs happened within a few days. This is obviously no accident!
